reviewer: Codex inspection of sixteen time-ordered frames
reason: Water visibly floods the workbench, but around 2.5 seconds the real yacht fades in behind and overlaps the still-intact paper boat. Paper edges do not fold or deform into the yacht sail/hull; the superimposed vessels constitute a dissolve rather than coherent metamorphosis. The later yacht/wake is usable footage, but this complete take fails the assigned transformation role.
revisionInstructions: Use connected mesh deformation, material conversion and one scene/camera; do not accept replacement or overlap as transformation.
